locations.label: Jail / Arthur
locations.description: Enter the jail from above and take the key on the wall to open Arthur’s cell. Give him the bottle of booze from inside. He charges away from the player who hands it over, so position his back toward the barrier you want broken. Free the Jugger-Nog alley and the approach to the mansion early. If you shoot him, he retreats to his cell; search the jail, courthouse judge’s bench, upstairs saloon or bank for the key to release him again. Area shown on an original schematic; use these landmark directions for the exact interaction.

locations.label: General Store parts region
locations.description: Use the General Store’s ground floor and upstairs landing to collect the trap parts. Deliver each piece before picking up another; a character can carry only one buildable part. If you want Arthur to help, install the first piece of the desired device at the chosen bench before giving him candy there. Turbine: tail fin on the ground-floor corner bookshelf; mannequin in the back-room corner; fan on an upstairs shelf. Resonator: roulette wheel/speaker by the weapon-locker counter; turntable on the ground floor near the locker; wooden base at the rear passage; motor at the top of the stairs. Head Chopper: crank on the centre shelf; hinge on the front counter’s right; saw in the barrel behind the counter’s left; stand in the rear room. Trample Steam: collect the mesh screen, motor, bellows and flag from the General Store; its workbench does not supply parts from Die Rise. Area shown on an original schematic; use these landmark directions for the exact interaction.

locations.label: Below-gazebo Pack-a-Punch
locations.description: Navigate the hedge maze from the mansion’s rear to the gazebo, checking the metal gates for the current route. Its configuration can change between rounds. At the gazebo, descend the spiral stairway for Pack-a-Punch and pay 5,000 points. Stop on each stair segment: there are gaps that can kill you if you rush or backpedal. Keep a teammate watching the approach while a weapon is inside the machine. Area shown on an original schematic; use these landmark directions for the exact interaction.

locations.label: Church Vulture Aid
locations.description: There is no central power switch. Jugger-Nog is at the end of the blocked alley by the jail; Speed Cola is upstairs in General Store; Mule Kick is upstairs in the gunsmith; Stamin-Up is in the courthouse; Double Tap is at the mansion entrance; Vulture Aid is in Church; Quick Revive is near the starting drop. Vulture Aid highlights useful objects and creates occasional ammunition/point drops and green hiding clouds. Area shown on an original schematic; use these landmark directions for the exact interaction.
